target: Suomi-NPP VIIRS reported detections per state-clipped 0.5 degree cell-month
backward_audit_status: Newly reserved for this experiment; not a guaranteed never-inspected test. Earlier published monthly artifacts include 2012.
spatial_audit: Fit only latitude <39.5 in all states, evaluate California latitude >=39.5, 2023-2025. Remove all training cells within 0.5 degrees of audit cells to prevent cross-state boundary leakage.
baseline: California training-only month-specific ratios; pooled-west model uses west training-only ratios; adapted model uses state ratios with global fallback.
candidate_selection: Select GAM penalty using mean California statewide monthly MAE across the two development folds. Select final model by California 2021-2022 monthly MAE. Baseline wins ties.
promotion_gate: At least 5% lower California selection monthly MAE than baseline AND selection cell-month MAE and north/south monthly MAE each no more than 5% worse than baseline. Known benchmark and backward/spatial audits are disclosed, never used for selection.
quality: Same vegetation/confidence predicate as v1; omit any paired month with listed MODIS or SNPP missing days. Missing/unavailable targets are never zeros.
exposure_policy: Hotspot-only acquisition/geometry features describe detected pixels, not observation exposure. Mask pilot is separate and is not fed into a full-period model unless matched coverage is available across its fitting and application periods.
